title: Be able to + or - delay activity time
symptom: The user wants to be able to input a delay for activity entries, similar to carb entries, to record activities that started in the past or will start in the future.
fix: The user found that entering activity via the carbs menu (even without entering carbs) allows setting a delay and changes the target, so the request is closed as not needed.
evidence_quote: If you enter activity via _carbs_ menu (even without entering carbs) you can delay + or - (thus my request is no more justified ;) ) and the target changes.
